So the equity-statement line is used. rule_proposal: one_source_per_row (ruling 13): the equity-statement line "Issuance of stock awards" (StockIssuedDuringPeriodValueShareBasedCompensation) is printed every year FY2015-FY2025, so the whole PM sbc row should serve it. The 2026-11-17 fix served FY2016-FY2025 from the Stock Plans note RSU+PSU sums (e.g. 2023 212, 2024 227, 2025 254 vs equity line 193, 195, 208) - those years need to be re-served from the equity line for one source per row.
